Earlier in Matryoshka campaigns targeting France, Germany, Hungary, and more, we saw the same pattern (and collected ample evidence):

• view count jumps into large 10Ks BEFORE a post gains a single like or retweet, on accounts dormant for years with <100 followers

• and then flatlines forever

Across 20 campaign posts targeting the US midterms, we proved with verifiable evidence that Matryoshka artificially inflates view counts and other engagement metrics.

While the average post in thie campaign shows 56K views on X, only ~2.1K (3.8%) of them could be organic.
